title: The Starving Light
text: A light floats in the dark, small and pale and lonely. It drifts toward your lamps, and they gutter and dim as it nears, the flames bending toward it. It is hungry. It is always hungry.

options.label: Feed it a lamp. Nothing should be that hungry.

outcomes.text: It drinks the flame and grows bright, and goes ahead of you, lighting the way.

options.label: The cleverest traps it in a jar, before it eats every light you have.

outcomes.text: A jar of starlight, beating against the glass.
It eats the jar, and keeps eating, and it tastes like you.

options.label: Douse every light and let it pass. Better dark than devoured.

outcomes.text: Utter dark, until it goes, and it takes its time.
